visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two muscular Asian men are seated on a red gym bench. The man on the left, wearing a black tank top and featuring blonde-dyed hair, looks down at a smartphone in his hand. The man on the right, with dark curly hair and tattoos on his chest and arms, gestures broadly towards the background gym equipment while speaking. The setting is a brightly lit, modern fitness center with multiple strength-training workout stations and a few other patrons visible in the distant background. (2) A closer shot focuses on the two men from the chest up. The blonde-haired man gently grasps the tattooed man's forearm while speaking. His facial expression is serious, calm, and thoughtful. The tattooed man looks back at him intently, listening. Behind them, several people are using strength training machines, and the lighting remains bright and consistent, highlighting their physical definitions. (3) The tattooed man's face contorts into an expression of extreme emotional distress, looking as though he is about to cry. He clutches the fabric of his black tank top over his heart with his left hand while the blonde man continues to hold his right wrist. His eyes are squeezed shut in a display of melodramatic sorrow. The background clearly shows rows of silver dumbbells on a rack against the wall.

A male voice speaks with high energy and a friendly, inquisitive tone, discussing gym equipment. The ambient noise floor is extremely low, suggesting a controlled studio or post-produced environment. (2) The sentimental piano BGM continues consistently as the first voice fades. A second male voice with a deeper, calmer, and more professional narrative tone enters. He speaks with a steady cadence and moderate loudness, delivering a philosophical comparison. The acoustic space remains clean with high signal clarity. (3) The first male voice returns but with a drastic shift in quality. He emits high-pitched, strained vocalizations that simulate exaggerated sobbing and wailing. These sounds are sharp and highly aroused, cutting through the persistent, calm piano music to create a sharp comedic contrast with the established mood.
